summary: Optimi Health Corp., a Vancouver-based commercial-stage psychedelic pharmaceutical manufacturer listed on Nasdaq (OPTH), filed a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing a planned multisite Phase 2 clinical trial of psilocybin-assisted therapy for major depressive disorder. The Health Canada-authorized trial will enroll up to 200 participants across Canadian sites, evaluating a single supervised dose of naturally derived psilocybin, with a primary endpoint of change in MADRS total score, initiation in the first half of 2027 and dosing complete by end-2027. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated; the company cites cash on hand for funding. This is a routine operational/clinical update, not a special situation; monitor regulatory and readout milestones rather than deal mechanics.
